units.source_text: 我看见母亲的幻影，什么话也没讲，你就说：“你看见妈妈怎么啦？”

en.t: I saw a vision of my mother and said nothing, and you said, "What is wrong? Did you see your mother?"

units.source_text: 就这样，我们两人融为一体了。

en.t: In that way, the two of us became one.

units.source_text: 我确信任何力量也不能把我们分开。

en.t: I was certain that no power could separate us.

units.source_text: 我也就安心地同你分手，去参加母亲的葬礼。

en.t: So I could part from you with peace of mind and go attend my mother's funeral.

units.source_text: 这就是我们之间的关系。

en.t: This is the relationship between us.
